# ionCube PHP 8.2 Loader

Unmodified ionCube Loader 15.5.1 for Linux x86-64 (non-thread-safe PHP).
This binary and its license come from the archive linked on the
[ionCube downloads page](https://www.ioncube.com/loaders.php).

When updating the loader, replace the binary and license together, update
its checksum in the build script and bump the Debian package version in
both the loader control file and the PHP package's pre-dependency.
